state.success: Finds the target slot whose move equals gLastMoves[target], then writes its move id and slot position. The target PP at that position must be nonzero and no target Encore may already exist.
state.timer: After the move/id position writes, the command consumes exactly one Random() result and stores (Random() & 3) + 3 into both target timer fields. Random returns gRngValue >> 16 after advancing the LCG.
state.expiry: At ENDTURN_ENCORE, replacement of the stored slot move clears encoredMove/timer silently; otherwise decrement first, then timer zero or encored-slot PP zero clears both and runs BattleScript_EncoredNoMore.

admission.choice: Before ordinary AI selection, the action-selection state replaces gChosenMoveByBattler and chosen move position with target-owned encoredMove/encoredMovePos whenever encoredMove is nonzero.
admission.execution: At move execution, a still-matching target-owned encored move overwrites gCurrentMove/gChosenMove and their positions. A slot overwrite clears encoredMove, encoredMovePos, and encoreTimer before using the live slot move.
admission.limitations: CheckMoveLimitations marks every slot not equal to target-owned encoredMove whenever encoreTimer is nonzero. Its Disable, Torment, Taunt, Imprison, and Choice predicates are independent and combine in the same mask loop.
admission.struggle: AreAllMovesUnusable exposes BattleScript_NoMovesLeft; later selection replaces the move with Struggle and sets HITMARKER_NO_PPDEDUCT. Encore itself neither owns that fallback nor a controller command.

lifetime.switch: SwitchInClearSetData zeroes the active DisableStruct and resets gLastMoves.
lifetime.batonPass: Baton Pass also zeroes the DisableStruct, then restores only substituteHP, battlerWithSureHit, both Perish Song timer fields, battlerPreventingEscape, and truantSwitchInHack: no Encore field survives.
lifetime.faint: FaintClearSetData zeroes status2, statuses3, and the active DisableStruct, then resets gLastMoves.

boundedRemainder: The public OFF manifest exposes active move id, PP, RNG, controller state, party checksums, and framebuffer hashes, but not gLastMoves, DisableStruct fields, script PC/result flags, controller buffers, AI chosen-slot state, or the expiry message ID. It proves a real prior Tackle, successful Encore PP spend, target-side Tackle PP spends while the effect is active, repeat Encore PP spend/failure, and deterministic output. The timer formula/draw ordering, exact failure predicates, forced-choice replacement, expiry, interactions with Disable/Torment, and switch/faint/Baton Pass cleanup are source-pinned; the identical four Chansey slots intentionally cannot distinguish a free post-expiry Tackle from a forced one. No production opcode is registered.
